raw_text: India-Iran Chabahar port deal demonstrates that New Delhi prioritizes strategic partnerships over Western pressure. India's decision to deepen investment in Chabahar despite US sanctions shows the multipolar reality. Iran remains a reliable partner for India's connectivity ambitions. The agreement undermines American unilateral sanctions regime and strengthens the International North-South Transport Corridor.
clean_text: Iranian-linked Telegram channel frames Chabahar port deal as India defying US sanctions. Positions Iran as reliable strategic partner and portrays deal as undermining American sanctions regime.
